TITLE: Measure your reaction time with just a ruler!

EN.친구가 30cm 자 끝을 잡고\n0 이 아래로 가게 세워요:
A friend holds the end of a 30 cm ruler
upright, with 0 at the bottom
EN.내 엄지와 검지를\n0 눈금에 살짝 벌려 둬요:
Hold your thumb and index finger
slightly open at the 0 mark
EN.친구가 말없이 놓으면\n최대한 빨리 잡아요!:
When your friend lets go without warning,
catch it as fast as you can!
EN.언제 놓을지 몰라요…: You never know when it'll drop…
EN.잡은 곳의 눈금을 읽어요: Read the mark where you caught it
EN.눈금을 표에서 찾으면\n내 반응 시간!:
Find that mark in the table —
that's your reaction time!
EN.15cm 에서 잡았다면\n0.17초 만에 잡은 거예요:
If you caught it at 15 cm,
you caught it in 0.17 seconds
EN.물건은 떨어질수록\n점점 빨라져요:
Falling things
get faster and faster
EN.그래서 떨어진 거리만 보면\n걸린 시간을 알 수 있어요:
So just from how far it fell,
you can tell how long it took
EN.반응 시간 = 눈으로 보고\n뇌를 거쳐 손이 움직이는 시간:
Reaction time = the time from your eyes seeing it,
through your brain, to your hand moving
EN.세 번 재서\n가족과 비교해 보세요!:
Measure three times
and compare with your family!
EN.자가 얼굴에 닿지 않게 조심!: Be careful the ruler doesn't hit your face!
